name: Accordion
issueBody:
### Description
Add an accordion component for collapsible content panels with keyboard accessibility and smooth height transition.

### Requirements
- Single and multiple expansion mode support
- Keyboard navigation (Up/Down arrow keys, Enter/Space to expand)

prTitle: feat: implement accessible accordion component
prBody:
### Summary

### Changes
- Added accordion stylesheet with CSS transition support
- Implemented Accordion class with keyboard event listeners
- Added live demo in docs showcase
